title: quai.toml
description: A Quai project manifest. Everything is optional: a plain static directory deploys without one.

name.description: Defaults to the directory name, which is what makes redeploying idempotent.

type.description: static serves files with no process; service runs a long-lived process; function is a single handler Quai hosts.

runtime.description: Which runtime hosts the project. Detected from the files when omitted.

build.description: Runs on your machine, never on the server.

output.description: Directory to ship instead of the whole project, e.g. dist.

internal_port.description: Declared, never guessed. Two projects may use the same port: each has its own network namespace.

start.description: Command that starts the process, e.g. node server.js. For a function, the handler file.

memory.description: e.g. 256Mi, 1Gi. Exceeding it kills the project, not its neighbours.

cpu.description: Fraction of a core, e.g. 0.5 or 2.

pids.description: Maximum processes. This is what contains a fork bomb.

disk.description: e.g. 1Gi. Enforced by an XFS project quota.

timeout.description: Functions only, e.g. 30s. A stuck request gets a 504 rather than hanging.

custom.description: Served alongside the automatic subdomain. Removing one here retires it on the next deploy.

env.description: Variables for the process. PORT, HOME and USER are set by Quai and cannot be overridden.
